section.sectionSummaryBrief: The actual refinement of the world is accomplished through service in the three lines of Torah, service, and acts of kindness, rooted in fear.
section.t: And behold, the actual refinement of the world is accomplished through the service in the three lines of Torah, service, and acts of kindness.
[However, the service in all three lines must be with fear,
the beginning of service and its essence and its root77].
For just as the coming into being of the world was through the three lines of Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet,
so too the refinement of the world
(until the world becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He)
is through the service in all three lines.
And this is "And Yaakov dwelt in the land of his father's sojournings,"
for the matter of his father's sojournings
(the refinement of the world)
is through Yaakov,
the third and the tripartite among the Patriarchs78,
the chosen among the Patriarchs79,
because he is comprised of all three lines
(for Yaakov is Tiferet which includes also the attributes of Chesed and Gevurah),
as it is written80
"The God of my father Avraham and the Fear of Yitzchak was with me,"
for he had within him also from the attribute of Chesed
(Avraham)
and Gevurah
(the Fear of Yitzchak)81.
And this is also that the Torah is a tripartite light,
and also many matters in the Giving of the Torah relate to the concept of tripartite82,
for the purpose of the Giving of the Torah is to effect refinement in the world
(as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said83
that the Torah was given to make peace in the world),
and this is accomplished through service in the three lines,
the concept of tripartite.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Engaging in Torah, acts of kindness, and prayer with the community redeems the sparks from the physical world.
section.t: And this is also what our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said
(on the verse "He redeemed my soul in peace")
"Whoever engages in Torah, and acts of kindness, and prays with the community, it is as if he redeemed Me, etc.,"
that the redemption of the sparks in this physical world
[through which is accomplished "He redeemed me and my children from among the nations of the world" in its simple sense]
is through engagement in the three lines84
of Torah, service, and acts of kindness85.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The primary purpose of the soul's descent is to refine the world's sparks, and through this service an elevation is effected in the supernal three lines.
section.t: And behold, since the ultimate intent of the descent of the soul below is
(not for the elevation of repentance that is effected in the soul,
but rather)
in order to effect refinement and elevation of the sparks in the world
(as above, section 6),
it must be said,
that this, that through the service of man in the three lines of Torah, service, and acts of kindness an elevation is effected in the three lines of Chesed, Gevurah, and Tiferet above
(as above, section 3),
is primarily from the aspect that through service in these three lines the refinement of the world is accomplished,
which is the ultimate intent.
